lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Macal, I'm raising the rent. Two thousand more. And I need your visa papers by Sunday.
lines.direction: firm but polite, heavy Pakistani accent

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Two thousand? Wait — if you give me one more month, I mean, I can find the money.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: If I wait, I lose. The law is the law. Sunday, Macal.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ninety days in Dubai... and now the clock is really ticking.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا جَمَاعَة! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاكُوا فِي يَلَّا فْلُوَنْت. النَّهَارْدَه، مَكَّال عَنْدُه مُشْكِلَة كَبِيرَة... صَاحِبْ البَيْت عَايِز يِزَوِّد الإِيجَار، وَعَايِز الأَوْرَاق يَوْم الحَدّ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: لَمَّا تِحْتَاج تِتَفَاوَض، أَوْ تِخْتَلِف بِأَدَب... فِيه تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات هَتْسَمَعْهُم النَّهَارْدَه، رَكِّز مَعَايَا كُوَيِّس.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَوَّل وَاحِد: If you give me one more month... تَانِي وَاحِد: I understand your position, but... وَتَالِت وَاحِد: If I wait, I lose.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا، نِسْمَع مَكَّال بِيُوَاجِه المَوْقِف. وَبَعْدِين أَنَا هَفَسَّرْلَكُم كُلْ حَاجَة!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Mr. Qureshi, I've been a good tenant for two years. I always pay on time. If you give me one more month, I mean, I can find the money.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Macal, I know you are a good tenant. But costs are up everywhere. If I wait, I lose. The law is the law.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I understand your position, but two thousand more is a lot. That's almost half my salary. Can we meet in the middle? Maybe one thousand?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: One thousand, five hundred. Final. And I still need your visa copy by Sunday. Not Monday. Sunday.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: My visa... it expires soon. I'm waiting on Dune and Co. to renew it. If they don't sign, I have a real problem.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Then you should talk to them today. Not tomorrow. If the papers are late, I cannot help you. I have rules too.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. I'll bring the visa copy. And I'll bring the money. Thank you for the one month, I mean, the smaller increase.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Good. And Macal — if your company asks for a reference, I will say you are honest. But honest tenants still pay rent.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Understood. I live here since two years, Mr. Qureshi. I don't want to leave. I just need a little more time.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Then don't waste it. Sunday. Bring everything. And good luck with your company.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ninety days in Dubai. The clock is not just ticking. It's running.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب، يَا جَمَاعَة، تَعَالُوا نْشُوفْ مَكَّال قَالْ إِيهْ... أَوَّل تَعْبِير: If you give me one more month. يَعْنِي: لَوْ تِدِّينِي شَهْر كَمَان. بِنِسْتَخْدِمْهَا لَمَّا تِطْلُبْ فُرْصَة، أَوْ وَقْت زِيَادَة، بِأَدَب. زَيِّ: If you give me one more week, I'll finish the report.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: التَّانِي: I understand your position, but... يَعْنِي: أَنَا فَاهِمْ وِجْهَة نَظَرَك، لَكِن... دِي أَحْسَنْ طَرِيقَة تِخْتَلِف بِأَدَب... بِتَعْتَرِفْ بِحَقُّه، وَبَعْدِين تِحُطّ رَأْيَك. زَيِّ: I understand your position, but the price is too high for me.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالتَّالِت: If I wait, I lose. دِي شَرْط... بِنِسْتَخْدِمْ If مَعَ الحَاضِرْ لَمَّا نِتَكَلِّمْ عَنْ نَتِيجَة أَكِيدَة. يَعْنِي: لَوْ أَسْتَحْمَلْ، أَنَا الخَسْرَان. زَيِّ: If I don't call now, I lose the chance.
lines.direction: clear, giving rhythm to the phrase

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَمَّا الغَلْطَة... مَكَّال قَالْ: I live here since two years. وَدِي غَلْطَة شَائِعَة جِدًّا، لِأَنَّ فِي العَرَبِي بِنْقُولْ مِنْ سَنَتَيْن... فَبِنِتْرْجِمْهَا حَرْفِيًّا. الصَّح: I've lived here for two years، أَوْ I've been living here for two years.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خَلِّي بَالَك... since بِتَجِي مَعَ نُقْطَة المُبْتَدَى، وَ for بِتَجِي مَعَ المُدَّة. يَعْنِي: since two thousand twenty-three، لَكِن for two years. جَرِّبْهَا مَعَايَا... I've worked here for three months. تَحْفَظْهَا كُوَيِّس، وَتَقُولْهَا بِثِقَة!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Nour, I did it. I negotiated with the landlord. He agreed to fifteen hundred, not two thousand. If I bring the visa copy by Sunday, I keep the flat.
lines.direction: relieved, a little proud, walking fast

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Wait — you actually sat down with him and talked numbers? Macal, that's real progress. A month ago you would've just said yes.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I've lived here for two years, you know. I didn't want to lose it. And honestly, I understand his position too — costs are up everywhere.
lines.direction: calm, reflective, proud of the tense

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Look at you, using the perfect tense in a real fight. Okay, so what's the problem? You look like there's a problem.
lines.direction: playful then sharp, reading his face

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: He needs the visa copy by Sunday. But my visa renewal depends on a full-time offer from Dune and Co. And right now, I only have the internship.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Then we go to them tomorrow. If you don't ask for the offer, you won't get it. You just proved you can negotiate — now do it again.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yeah. You're right. If I wait, I lose. Tomorrow morning, I'm walking into that office.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Good. And Macal — whatever happens in there, don't say yes to the first number they give you. Promise me.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I promise. Ninety days left. And my visa... that clock is louder than ever.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب يَا جَمَاعَة... خَلِّينَا نِلَخِّصْ بِسُرْعَة! عِنْدِنَا ثَلاث تَعْبِيرَات... If you give me one more month، وَ I understand your position, but... وَ If I wait, I lose. دُولْ هُمَّا سِلاحَك فِي أَي مُفَاوَضَة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَمَا تِنْسَاش الغَلْطَة... I live here since two years. الصَّح: I've lived here for two years، يَعْنِي since مَعَ النُقْطَة، وَ for مَعَ المُدَّة. احْفَظْهَا كُوَيِّس!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الحَلْقَة النَّهَارْدَة... هِيَّ: If I don't ask, I won't get it. يَعْنِي: لَوْ مَا طَلَبْتْش، مِشْ حَاخُد. قُولْهَا لِنَفْسَك كُلْ يَوْم!
lines.direction: proud, giving the phrase with weight

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: انْضَمُّوا لِنَا عَلَى تِلِيجْرَام، وَاشْتَرِكُوا فِي البُودْكَاسْت... كُلْ أُسْبُوع حَلْقَة جَدِيدَة، وَتَدْرِيب مَعَاكُمْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالْمَرَّة الجَايَة... مَكَّال رَايِح لِمَكْتَب الشُّرْكَة. هَلْ حَايِخُد العَرْض؟ وَلَا التَّارِيك حَايِسْبِقُه؟ اسْتَعِدُّوا... الحَلْقَة الجَايَة هَتْكُون نَار!
